Score each onboarding change. Sub-scores:
- impact 0-3: how many users the targeted step loses and how much this could recover
- evidence 0-3: whether the funnel and the support mail both point at this problem
- confidence 0-2: how likely this kind of change works, judged from the lessons below
- cost 0-2: 2 = config only, 0 = needs new screens and a release
Also give predicted_lift: expected relative change in the target step's conversion, e.g. 0.05.

Changes:
0: [sign_in, reorder] Move sign-in after pet selection: Move sign-in to after pet selection so users choose their companion before creating an account. (why: Sign-in currently drops 27.1% of users early. Letting users pick their pet first builds emotional investment before account creation.)
1: [home, redesign] Desktop control carousel on loading screen: Redesign the waiting screen into a split layout showcasing an interactive desktop controls carousel while files load. (why: Waiting step takes a median of 201s and support receives multiple complaints from users confused on how to control/hide/talk to pets.)
2: [adoption, new_flow] Instant starter pet flow bypass: Add one-click instant starter pet choice cards on the selection screen to skip custom photo processing. (why: 3 support emails report custom pet generation errors or bad results, causing high adoption drop-off.)
3: [sign_in, hint] Account sync hint on sign-in screen: Display a hint warning returning users to use their original sign-in method to retain pets. (why: 8 support emails (the top issue) report pets missing or reset after signing in again.)
4: [home, wait_info] Desktop permission check during setup: Add a diagnostic checklist during the waiting screen to verify desktop overlay permissions. (why: 3 support emails mention the pet not appearing on desktop or the desktop overlay failing to open.)
5: [finish, copy] Clear control instructions on home intro: Update the welcome text with explicit copy on right-clicking the pet to bring up desktop controls. (why: Support receives multiple tickets asking how to control, hide, or talk to their pet post-onboarding.)
6: [choose_path, layout] Two-column progress view for path selection: Switch choose_path screen to a clear two-column layout with visual step progress counter. (why: 23.8% of users drop off at choose_path, spending a long mean time (514s) deciding.)
